description: Fudgy chunks of brownie goodness mixed into dark and rich chocolate ice cream. Sounds like a dream. At first, that's all it was. Long ago, we were making brownie ice cream sandwiches for sale in grocery stores. Sometimes there would be broken pieces in the brownie delivery, and we'd nab them for flavor experiments. name: Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Ice Cream Pint, 16 OZ
description: Big delicious chunks of chocolate chip cookie dough surrounded by creamy vanilla ice cream. It seems like such a no-brainer today, but in 1984 it was revolutionary. The Cookie Dough you know and love started with a simple suggestion: What if you put chunks of chocolate chip cookie dough into vanilla ice cream? That was the amazing anonymous idea submitted way back in the early days of our first Burlington, Vermont, USA, Scoop Shop. We used to have a bulletin board where people could suggest new flavours for Jerry and Ben to make—and this idea stood out. The folks at the Scoop Shop immediately went to work mixing up a batch of Cookie Dough. It was an instant hit. Initially, the flavour was only available at the Scoop Shop. When we decided to sell it in tubs, we had to figure out how to get that familiar cookie-dough taste, consistency and texture at ice cream temperatures. We teamed up with Rhino Foods and, over an incredible six-year journey, we perfected the cookie dough found in our tubs today. In 1991, Cookie Dough began appearing in freezer aisles everywhere. It has remained one of our most popular and beloved flavours ever since! We get our cocoa, sugar and vanilla from Fairtrade certified producers, while Caring Dairy farmers provide all the milk and cream in this tub. Ben & Jerry's ice cream is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. We also use responsibly sourced packaging. name: Sumatra Decaf
description: There are many variations of Sumatran coffee. All have a distinguished, robust, full body with a deep, complex flavor, low-toned acidity ad a lingering sweet finish. One of the world's most desired coffees.

name: Vermont Maple Nut Crunch Swp Decaf
description: Vermont maple syrup with a hint of walnuts. A wonderful new England coffee.

name: Ceylon Orange Pekoe
description: The medium-sized black-brownish leaves of this high-grown tea produce a deep amber cup with a brisk, well-rounded, and flowery taste.

name: Chamomile Organic
description: Chamomile blossoms have a mildly sweet and fruity flavor with a floral and soothing aroma. An infusion of chamomile is noted for its naturally calming energy and is one of the most popular caffeine-free herbal teas.

name: China Green Decaf
description: The large, dark, greenish-brown leaf brews to a light amber cup, and with a slightly sweet taste. This tea has more body than traditional green teas. Naturally decaffeinated using the co2 method.

name: China Gunpowder Green
description: A green tea is grown in the Yunnan district of china. The leaves are rolled into tight little pellets that resemble gunpowder.  Light, clear with an aroma that is reminiscent of a cool forest or meadow.

name: Cranberry Orange Tisane
description: A fruity blend of organic rosehips, organic orange peel, organic hibiscus, and natural flavors.

name: Dragon Well Green Organic
description: China's most famous tea! Dragon Well (Longjing) is grown in the fertile Longjing mountain area of Hangzhou and southwest of the west lake.  This mountainous region holds back the cold currents from the north and the warm currents from the south, resulting in long periods of cloud cover. These ideal growing conditions produce what may be considered the best tea in china.  Their flat, smooth leaves steep to emerald green liquor, and with a distinctive sweetness.

name: Earl Grey Fair-Trade and Organic
description: Earl Grey is a British tea classic and is the most popular tea in the western world. This citrus-scented tea blend has a rich history dating back to the 19th century sino-British trade of opium, tea, silk, and porcelain. This organic earl grey is a black tea blend of bold-flavored Yunnan Dian Hong harvested from antique tea trees infused with natural bergamot citrus from southern Italy.

name: English Breakfast Decaf
description: These black, medium-sized leaves produce copper liquor that has a bright, and fragrant cup. This tea is smooth and full-bodied with a malty aftertaste.

name: Ginger Peach Black
description: Juicy and ripe Georgia peaches with just the right amount of Asian ginger spice add a wonderful flavor sensation to our house blend of black teas.

name: Ginger Peach Black Decaf
description: Juicy and ripe Georgia peaches with just the right amount of Asian ginger spice add a wonderful flavor sensation to our blend of black teas. Decaffeinated.

name: Ginger Root Organic
description: A perennial originated in tropical Asia and is now cultivated in many areas around the globe. For thousands of years, ginger root has been important for culinary, and medicinal purposes. Try this tasty herb alone or with a combination of other herbs and teas.

name: Hibiscus Flowers Organic
description: 100% pure hibiscus tea made with only hibiscus flowers. A popular, healthy drink enjoyed since ancient times. Sometimes referred to as karkade, rosa de jamaica, Jamaican roselle, and red sorrell tea.

name: Irish Breakfast
description: A hearty breakfast blend of Assam, China, and Nilgiri black teas. A great morning tea.

name: Iron Goddess of Mercy Oolong
description: A specially baked tea is produced in the spring and winter. This special grade of tea is hand-harvested from the soft stem wu-Yi tea bush that is descended from the original tea bushes introduced to Taiwan from fuji in the 19th century. This tea has a light golden-amber infusion with a smooth body and sweet finish.

name: Jasmine Green Organic
description: Organic green tea blended with fresh jasmine blossoms by a traditional tea scenting process. The green tea absorbs the natural essence from fresh jasmine blossoms and imparts a sweet and soothing fragrance in every cup.

name: Lavender Flowers Organic
description: Use a small amount blended with other teas to create a wonderfully aromatic herbal blend. Lavender is frequently used as an aid to sleep and relax. Makes a great bedtime drink.

name: Lemon Balm Organic
description: Cut and sift organic lemon balm from the pacific northwest. Lemon balm is claimed to have antibacterial, antiviral properties, and it is also used as a mild sedative for a calming agent.

name: Luscious Lemon Herbal Tisane
description: A lemony blend that combines organic lemon peel, organic lemongrass, organic lemon balm, and lemon verbena with natural lemon flavor. Caffeine-free.

name: Masala Chai Fair-Trade and organic
description: A robust and full-flavored black tea blended with traditional Indian masala spices. Full notes of cardamom, ginger, and clove that's zesty and stimulating. Masala chai should be brewed strong and served sweet with steamed milk and sugar.

name: Pai-Mu-Tan White
description: From the fuji province comes this beautifully styled, elongated leafed tea with white tips, and gray-green leaves. The tea brews to a pale golden cup with a sweet and mellow taste.

name: Peppermint Organic
description: This is a wonderful tasting herb and a very beneficial one also. Peppermint is used for indigestion, relaxing stomach muscles, heartburn, general calming effects, and to help soothe a nagging cough. Great with a dash of honey.

name: Pu-erh Ancient Tuo Cha Fair-trade, and organic
description: Classic style compressed Pu-erh designed for an 8 oz infuser mug or teapot. Hand-harvested from the antique tea trees of jingmai managing, our pu-EHR tuo cha is rich, full-bodied, and smooth with a sweetly flavored infusion rarely found in this type of tea. Each tuo cha weighs 5 - 6 grams.

name: Rooibos Blueberry
description: Blueberry flavored rooibos with bilberry leaves, cornflowers, and blueberries.  Rooibos is processed from the leaf of the aspalathus linearis and while the liquor looks and tasted very much like tea, this is 100% caffeine-free.

name: Rooibos Chai Organic
description: Rich red rooibos, along with sweet cinnamon and aromatic cardamom, imparts a familiar taste to this caffeine-free chai blend. This tea mixes star anise, ginger, black pepper, and ramon nut to produce a truly original anytime chai. With its dark red infusion, rooibos chai is the perfect base for lattes and innovative cafe drinks.

name: Rooibos Vanilla
description: Incredibly velvety aroma, flavor transform rooibos into a sophisticated, and elegant herbal tea.

name: Rooibos Wild Cherry
description: South African red tea is high in antioxidants, flavonoids, low in harmful alkaloids, and tannins. The flavor is enhanced with wild cherry flavors.

name: Rose Hips
description: High-quality rose hips and seedless. Use as a standalone tea or blend with other herbals. Very high in vitamin c.

name: Spiced Apple Black
description: A black tea mixed with the lively, fruity flavor of fresh orchard apples, cinnamon, and warm spices.

name: Tulsi (Holy Basil) Organic
description: Native to India and tulsi is revered in ayurvedic medicine as a powerful healing plant. Our tulsi comes from northern India in the area known as south (awadh). Contains many antioxidants and is caffeine-free.

description: Fudgy chunks of brownie goodness mixed into dark and rich chocolate ice cream. Sounds like a dream. At first, that's all it was. Long ago, we were making brownie ice cream sandwiches for sale in grocery stores. Sometimes there would be broken pieces in the brownie delivery, and we'd nab them for flavor experiments. What would brownie pieces taste like in chocolate ice cream? Pretty good, as it turns out! That original experimental flavor eventually became the legendary ice cream concoction known as Chocolate Fudge Brownie. Meanwhile, Ben Cohen had met Bernie Glassman, the founder of Greyston Bakery, a Yonkers, New York, USA-based company with a mission to end poverty and give back to the community. Equally important, their brownies were just so darn good—after sampling some, Ben handwrote a note asking for two truckloads of brownie pieces. While we knew Greyston would be the ideal supplier for turning Chocolate Fudge Brownie into a flavor sold by the tub, getting the brownies to cooperate wasn't easy. After about 25 batches of brownies and six months of work, the flavor finally debuted in 1991, and it's been a hit ever since. All Ben & Jerry's ice cream is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. The cocoa, sugar and vanilla in Chocolate Fudge Brownie is Fairtrade . And all our packaging is responsibly sourced. Greyston Bakery, one of the largest social enterprises in the USA, continues to provide the brownies for this and all of our flavors." name: CHEESE FRIES
description:
What do you get when you’re craving salty and savory? Charleys Cheese Fries. Our cheese fries are made with all-natural cut potatoes, tossed in salt and pepper, then smothered with our signature melted cheddar cheese sauce. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries. They're perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Charleys Cheese Fries pair perfectly with the Chicken California cheesesteak or Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: PHILLY CHEESESTEAK
description:
The original. The classic. The Steak Philly. Our steak philly cheesesteak is always made with high-quality USDA choice steak, grilled and seasoned to perfection. We add savory grilled green peppers, mushrooms, and onions and top off our cheesesteak with melted provolone cheese. This delicious cheesesteak is always served on a signature toasted roll.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Steak Philly pairs perfectly with French Fries or Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: TURKEY CHEDDAR MELT
description:
Bet you can’t name a better pair than turkey and cheddar cheese. Our Turkey Cheddar melt comes loaded with sliced warm turkey and melted shredded cheddar cheese, all served on a buttery toasted roll.  This is the turkey cheddar sandwich you’ve been waiting for.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Turkey Cheddar Melt pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries and a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade.

name: CHICKEN BUFFALO
description:
Who says a sandwich can’t bring the heat? Our Chicken Buffalo cheesesteak features USDA-choice grilled chicken infused with spicy buffalo sauce and topped with smooth, melted provolone cheese. All served on our signature toasted roll. We recommend adding some ranch dressing to this buffalo chicken cheesesteak if you want to bring down the spice. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Pepperoni Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Original French Fries or a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade.

name: ULTIMATE FRIES
description:
Charleys Ultimate Fries are truly the ultimate indulgence. Charleys Cheese and Bacon Fries are made with our all-natural cut potatoes, fried, and seasoned with salt and pepper. We smother our fries with our signature melted cheddar cheese sauce, creamy Ranch dressing, top it all off with crispy bacon pieces. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries.  They’re perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Ultimate Fries pair perfectly with the Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak and Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: FIESTA CHEESESTEAK
description: The Fiesta Cheesesteak brings a new, bold flavor blend to Charleys Cheesesteaks! Our new limited-time-offering is crafted with Tex-Mex seasoned USDA choice steak, zesty Pepper Jack cheese, spicy jalapeños, plus sautéed sliced green peppers and onions, lettuce, and sliced tomato. The Fiesta Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Fiesta Fries and a real-fruit lemonade.

name: CHICKEN PHILLY
description: The Chicken Philly Cheesesteak is made just for chicken lovers. This cheesesteak features chicken seasoned just right and grilled with fresh green peppers, savory onions, and sliced mushrooms. We top the Chicken Philly with smooth, melted provolone cheese and serve it on our signature toasted roll. We love steak, but this chicken cheesesteak gives the Steak Philly a run for its money. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken Philly pairs perfectly with the not-too-sweet, not-too-tart taste of Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Chicken California pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or Real-Fruit Strawberry Lemonade.

description:

Charleys real-fruit strawberry lemonade is the sweet, fruity drink of your dreams. We start with our original formula of lemon juice, cane sugar, and water. Then we top it off with sweetened pureed strawberries, creating a perfectly blended strawberry lemonade. 

Real-fruit strawberry lemonade pairs perfectly with Cheese Fries or the Chicken California Cheesesteak.

name: PEACH LEMONADE
description:
This craveable real-fruit lemonade is just...peachy. We pair our original lemonade recipe (lemon juice, cane sugar, and water) with diced peaches stewed at the peak of freshness. Quench your sweet tooth with summery goodness in every sip.

Our real-fruit peach lemonade pairs perfectly with the Pepperoni Cheesesteak and Ultimate Fries.

name: PHILLY CHEESESTEAK
description:
The original. The classic. The Steak Philly. Our steak philly cheesesteak is always made with high-quality USDA choice steak, grilled and seasoned to perfection. We add savory grilled green peppers, mushrooms, and onions and top off our cheesesteak with melted provolone cheese. This delicious cheesesteak is always served on a signature toasted roll.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Steak Philly pairs perfectly with French Fries or Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: FIESTA FRIES
description: Topped with USDA Choice Steak, Tex Mex Seasoning, Pepperjack Cheese, Jalapenos, Sauteed Green Peppers and Onions

name: BACON 3 CHEESESTEAK
description:
Calling all bacon lovers! We have the cheesesteak for you. Our Bacon 3 cheesesteak features seasoned grilled steak topped with crispy, salty bacon and sharp melted Swiss cheese. This steak and bacon cheesesteak is served on our signature toasted roll for extra crispiness in every bite. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Bacon 3 Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or a soft drink.

name: CHICKEN TERIYAKI
description:
The Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak: the perfect blend of savory, sweet, and zingy all in one sandwich. This chicken cheesesteak is made with USDA-choice chicken grilled with savory onions and infused with sweet, umami teriyaki sauce. We contrast the sweetness of the teriyaki with a layer of sharp melted Swiss cheese, all served on our signature toasted roll. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries or a Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: ULTIMATE FRIES
description:
Charleys Ultimate Fries are truly the ultimate indulgence. Charleys Cheese and Bacon Fries are made with our all-natural cut potatoes, fried, and seasoned with salt and pepper. We smother our fries with our signature melted cheddar cheese sauce, creamy Ranch dressing, top it all off with crispy bacon pieces. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries.  They’re perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Ultimate Fries pair perfectly with the Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak and Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: FIESTA CHEESESTEAK
description: The Fiesta Cheesesteak brings a new, bold flavor blend to Charleys Cheesesteaks! Our new limited-time-offering is crafted with Tex-Mex seasoned USDA choice steak, zesty Pepper Jack cheese, spicy jalapeños, plus sautéed sliced green peppers and onions, lettuce, and sliced tomato. The Fiesta Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Fiesta Fries and a real-fruit lemonade.

name: CHICKEN PHILLY
description: The Chicken Philly Cheesesteak is made just for chicken lovers. This cheesesteak features chicken seasoned just right and grilled with fresh green peppers, savory onions, and sliced mushrooms. We top the Chicken Philly with smooth, melted provolone cheese and serve it on our signature toasted roll. We love steak, but this chicken cheesesteak gives the Steak Philly a run for its money. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken Philly pairs perfectly with the not-too-sweet, not-too-tart taste of Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: PHILLY CHEESESTEAK
description:
The original. The classic. The Steak Philly. Our steak philly cheesesteak is always made with high-quality USDA choice steak, grilled and seasoned to perfection. We add savory grilled green peppers, mushrooms, and onions and top off our cheesesteak with melted provolone cheese. This delicious cheesesteak is always served on a signature toasted roll.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Steak Philly pairs perfectly with French Fries or Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: CHICKEN CALIFORNIA
description:
Our Chicken California cheesesteak is the perfect blend of savory, creamy, and zesty. We season and grill USDA-choice chicken and melt in smooth provolone cheese. We serve it on our signature toasted roll to add some crispiness to every bite of your cheesesteak. Then we top it off with creamy ranch dressing. What’s not to love? 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Chicken California pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or Real-Fruit Strawberry Lemonade.

name: PEPPERONI CHEESESTEAK
description:
Charleys’ Pepperoni Cheesesteak started as a fan favorite. We loved it so much, we made it a permanent menu item! This steak cheesesteak features seasoned, grilled steak and spicy pepperoni with grilled green peppers, savory onion, and mouth-watering sliced mushrooms. We top it off with smooth melted provolone cheese and serve it all on our signature toasted roll. You’ll get a mouthful of zesty flavor with every bite. (You can even add jalapeño for extra spice!) 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Pepperoni Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries or a soft drink.

name: CHICKEN BUFFALO
description:
Who says a sandwich can’t bring the heat? Our Chicken Buffalo cheesesteak features USDA-choice grilled chicken infused with spicy buffalo sauce and topped with smooth, melted provolone cheese. All served on our signature toasted roll. We recommend adding some ranch dressing to this buffalo chicken cheesesteak if you want to bring down the spice. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Pepperoni Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Original French Fries or a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade.

name: BACON 3 CHEESESTEAK
description:
Calling all bacon lovers! We have the cheesesteak for you. Our Bacon 3 cheesesteak features seasoned grilled steak topped with crispy, salty bacon and sharp melted Swiss cheese. This steak and bacon cheesesteak is served on our signature toasted roll for extra crispiness in every bite. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Bacon 3 Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or a soft drink.

name: CHICKEN TERIYAKI
description:
The Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak: the perfect blend of savory, sweet, and zingy all in one sandwich. This chicken cheesesteak is made with USDA-choice chicken grilled with savory onions and infused with sweet, umami teriyaki sauce. We contrast the sweetness of the teriyaki with a layer of sharp melted Swiss cheese, all served on our signature toasted roll. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries or a Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: TURKEY CHEDDAR MELT
description:
Bet you can’t name a better pair than turkey and cheddar cheese. Our Turkey Cheddar melt comes loaded with sliced warm turkey and melted shredded cheddar cheese, all served on a buttery toasted roll.  This is the turkey cheddar sandwich you’ve been waiting for.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Turkey Cheddar Melt pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries and a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade.

name: ULTIMATE CLUB
description:
This isn’t your average club sandwich. Our Ultimate Club cheesesteak comes loaded with sliced turkey, perfectly salted sliced ham, crispy bacon strips, and shredded cheddar cheese for added zest. This is the perfect deli sandwich served on a buttery toasted roll.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Ultimate Club pairs perfectly with Cheese Fries and an Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: ITALIAN DELUXE
description:
The Italian Deluxe comes loaded with sliced meats including turkey, ham, and spiced pepperoni and topped off with smooth, melted provolone cheese. It's a meat lover's dream come true.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.

The Italian Deluxe pairs perfectly with Original French Fries or a Real-Fruit Strawberry Lemonade.

name: VEGGIE DELIGHT
description:
Veggie lovers rejoice! Our Veggie Delight cheesesteak features grilled sliced mushrooms, crispy green peppers and savory onion grilled to perfection and served on a toasted roll. We top our Veggie Delight with smooth melted provolone, mellow shredded cheddar cheese, and sharp Swiss to enhance the flavors of our featured veggies. This is the veggie sandwich you’ve been waiting for. 

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. 

The Veggie Delight pairs perfectly with Cheese Fries or an Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: FIESTA FRIES
description: Topped with USDA Choice Steak, Tex Mex Seasoning, Pepperjack Cheese, Jalapenos, Sauteed Green Peppers and Onions

name: ORIGINAL FRIES
description:
Our Original French Fries are made with all-natural cut potatoes, fried to perfection, and tossed in salt and pepper. Charleys fries are served ready to be dipped in ketchup (but are also delicious on their own!) Order them in small and large sizes. Enjoy them a la carte to fulfill the “snacking occasion” or as part of an Original Combo, paired with your favorite hot Cheesesteak and your choice of refreshing regular-sized beverage.

Charleys Original French Fries pair perfectly with Original Real-Fruit Lemonade or a Philly Cheesesteak.

name: CHEESE FRIES
description:
What do you get when you’re craving salty and savory? Charleys Cheese Fries. Our cheese fries are made with all-natural cut potatoes, tossed in salt and pepper, then smothered with our signature melted cheddar cheese sauce. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries. They're perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Charleys Cheese Fries pair perfectly with the Chicken California cheesesteak or Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: CHEESE & BACON FRIES
description:
Bacon lovers, rejoice. Charleys Cheese and Bacon Fries are made with our all-natural cut potatoes, tossed in salt and pepper, smothered with signature melted cheddar cheese sauce and sprinkled with crispy bacon pieces. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries. They're perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Cheese and Bacon Fries pair perfectly with a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade or a Chicken Philly cheesesteak.

name: ULTIMATE FRIES
description:
Charleys Ultimate Fries are truly the ultimate indulgence. Charleys Cheese and Bacon Fries are made with our all-natural cut potatoes, fried, and seasoned with salt and pepper. We smother our fries with our signature melted cheddar cheese sauce, creamy Ranch dressing, top it all off with crispy bacon pieces. Forks are optional but highly recommended with these Gourmet Fries.  They’re perfect for any “snacking occasion” or as part of a Gourmet Combo. 

Ultimate Fries pair perfectly with the Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak and Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

Introduced in 1876, The King of Beers is a crisp, refreshing American-style lager. Served with fries.
